newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina says early wheat exports accelerating.
newsitem.headline: Argentina says early wheat exports accelerating.

text.p: Argentina's early season wheat exports are proceeding apace and are set to pick up more speed next week, the government's Agriculture Secretariat said Thursday.

"With just over 15 percent of the crop harvested, 400,000 tonnes have already been shipped to diverse foreign destinations. According to official and shipping sources, it is expected that this rhythm should pick up even further between this week and next," the Secretariat said in a statement.
Thirty-two ships are now in Argentine ports or expected to arrive soon, to carry 700,000 tonnes of wheat to countries including Brazil, Morocco, Indonesia, Algeria, Egypt, Iran and Chile.
"This level of shipments, which constitutes a record, eloquently demonstrates the improvement in our ports' efficiency," the Secretariat said.
